doc.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007

chapter: The club dream, pay and wrap-up
title: Staying in New York and the club idea
summary: New York has the musicians and tourists, and he needs a believer to fund his club.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well did we get you on your soapbox enough today?
I think so. I think so.
Have you ever considered not living in New York?

No. No. New York is the capital of the world and the musicians are here. Last year our mayor said that 45 million tourists came to New York. There’s your audience. I’m not saying that we need 45 million people in my club, in this club idea, but if we get one zillionth of a percentile, there’s the place. And the next night there’s another bunch of folks. I know it’s expensive but if you have someone believe in what you do, as people have believed in opera and classical music or a certain hospital or a certain cause, anything is possible. You just have to have Mr. or Ms. Right there.
Right. You’ve got to find that person.
